raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From Strawberry Fields, carry on to the Dakota, about a three-minute walk.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Look up at the turrets and spires — the place looks like a castle, and that was entirely the point.","source_id":"f19b1ae6-9621-43f1-92e2-0afdb473aee3","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"The idea was to convince wealthy New Yorkers that living in an apartment could feel every bit as luxurious as owning a whole house.","source_id":"f19b1ae6-9621-43f1-92e2-0afdb473aee3","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"It worked from the day it was completed in 1884, designed by Henry J. Hardenbergh, back when the Upper West Side was so desolate they named it after the remote Dakota Territory.","source_id":"ff4aaf76-bc67-487c-862e-326be103e48c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2,"also_cites":["c253fa03-682f-404d-93b4-8e7e1788185e"]},{"text":"Nine stories of German Renaissance stonework — reliefs, balconies, gables — the building dragged the whole neighborhood upmarket, and in 1976 it was named a National Historic Landmark.","source_id":"ff4aaf76-bc67-487c-862e-326be103e48c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Strip away the fame, though, and it's really just an upscale apartment building.","source_id":"c253fa03-682f-404d-93b4-8e7e1788185e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Never an ordinary one, mind you — Judy Garland lived here, so did Leonard Bernstein.","source_id":"d6a67f47-e345-4b61-ab5b-66cefe813b1e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"And in 1968 it played the sinister Bramford in Rosemary's Baby, home to the Woodhouses, Rosemary and John, played by Mia Farrow and John Cassavetes.","source_id":"d6a67f47-e345-4b61-ab5b-66cefe813b1e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Don't expect to get inside, either — the residents guard their privacy fiercely, and a taciturn doorman holds the entrance around the clock.","source_id":"d6a67f47-e345-4b61-ab5b-66cefe813b1e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"That guarded quiet was shattered on December 8, 1980, when John Lennon was shot dead on the street right outside his home, 1 West 72nd Street on Central Park West.","source_id":"c253fa03-682f-404d-93b4-8e7e1788185e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2,"also_cites":["6a8358b5-b2e2-4c28-a06c-270bb9daf3d6"]},{"text":"People have flocked to this building ever since.","source_id":"c253fa03-682f-404d-93b4-8e7e1788185e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"And to this day, his widow, Yoko Ono, still lives inside.","source_id":"c253fa03-682f-404d-93b4-8e7e1788185e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2}]}
